questions.q: In the two-heap method, what is stored in the max-heap?
options: The lower half of the numbers
why: The upper half is in the min-heap.

questions.q: Numbers so far: 1, 2, 3, 100. What is the median?
questions.why: Even count: the two middle numbers are 2 and 3. The mean is 2.5.

questions.q: Scenario: your moving-median code is correct but slow for k = 50,000 because you sort each window. What is the best fix?
options: Two heaps with lazy deletion (or a sorted container)

questions.q: Scenario: a sensor shows a value of 10,000 for one second. You smooth with a window of 5. Which smoother is least affected?
why: Correct: one outlier does not change the middle value much.

questions.q: What is the amortised time per step of the lazy-deletion moving median?
why: That is the sorted list with memmove.
